definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.taxonomy_handoff_compatible_v1(need_handoff jsonb, worker_handoff jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 -- Historical missing data stays unknown; it is never rewritten as shipment
 -- consent. Existing unqualified tasks keep their prior compatibility policy.
 IF need_handoff IS NULL THEN RETURN true; END IF;
 IF NOT private.taxonomy_handoff_valid_v1(need_handoff) THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF need_handoff->'required'='false'::jsonb THEN
   RETURN worker_handoff IS NULL OR (private.taxonomy_handoff_valid_v1(worker_handoff)
     AND worker_handoff->'required'='false'::jsonb);
 END IF;
 IF worker_handoff IS NULL OR NOT private.taxonomy_handoff_valid_v1(worker_handoff)
    OR worker_handoff->'required'<>'true'::jsonb THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 RETURN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(need_handoff->'shippingCountries','[]'::jsonb)) n(country)
   JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(worker_handoff->'shippingCountries','[]'::jsonb)) w(country) USING(country))
   OR (need_handoff ? 'localExchange' AND worker_handoff ? 'localExchange'
     AND need_handoff#>>'{localExchange,countryCode}'=worker_handoff#>>'{localExchange,countryCode}'
     AND private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(need_handoff#>>'{localExchange,city}')=
         private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(worker_handoff#>>'{localExchange,city}'));
END $function$

definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.taxonomy_handoff_valid_v1(p_value jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_city text;
BEGIN
 IF jsonb_typeof(p_value) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
    OR octet_length(p_value::text)>2048
    OR jsonb_typeof(p_value->'required') IS DISTINCT FROM 'boolean'
    OR p_value-array['required','shippingCountries','localExchange']<>'{}'::jsonb
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF p_value->'required'='false'::jsonb THEN RETURN p_value='{"required":false}'::jsonb; END IF;
 IF NOT(p_value?'shippingCountries' OR p_value?'localExchange') THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF p_value?'shippingCountries' THEN
   IF jsonb_typeof(p_value->'shippingCountries') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN RETURN false; END IF;
   IF jsonb_array_length(p_value->'shippingCountries') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 32
     OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_value->'shippingCountries') x(value)
       WHERE jsonb_typeof(x.value) IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR x.value#>>'{}' !~ '^[A-Z]{2}$')
     OR (SELECT count(DISTINCT x.value) FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_value->'shippingCountries') x(value))
         <>jsonb_array_length(p_value->'shippingCountries')
   THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 END IF;
 IF p_value?'localExchange' THEN
   IF jsonb_typeof(p_value->'localExchange') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
     OR NOT((p_value->'localExchange')?&array['countryCode','city'])
     OR (p_value->'localExchange')-array['countryCode','city']<>'{}'::jsonb
     OR jsonb_typeof(p_value#>'{localExchange,countryCode}') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
     OR p_value#>>'{localExchange,countryCode}' !~ '^[A-Z]{2}$'
     OR jsonb_typeof(p_value#>'{localExchange,city}') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   THEN RETURN false; END IF;
   v_city:=p_value#>>'{localExchange,city}';
   IF v_city IS DISTINCT FROM btrim(v_city,
      U&'\0009\000A\000B\000C\000D\0020\00A0\1680\2000\2001\2002\2003\2004\2005\2006\2007\2008\2009\200A\2028\2029\202F\205F\3000\FEFF')
      OR char_length(v_city) NOT BETWEEN 3 AND 120
      OR v_city ~ ('['||chr(1)||'-'||chr(31)||chr(127)||'-'||chr(159)||'<>0-9]')
   THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN true;
END $function$
